_note: Plain-language explanations of the demos' model-written findings, written by hand by the site owner (the demo reviews were saved before the model wrote these itself). Rule findings get theirs from backend/shared/stakeholder/catalog.py. Never put a dollar amount here: scripts/build_demo_stakeholder.py prices fix_components from the price table.

a5c4e002-aa8f-4088-a26e-3ba59830ba84.title: Storage traffic doesn't use a private route
a5c4e002-aa8f-4088-a26e-3ba59830ba84.analogy: Like using a public road between two of your own buildings when a private tunnel is free.
a5c4e002-aa8f-4088-a26e-3ba59830ba84.what_could_happen: If the bucket's settings slip, nothing makes it refuse requests from outside your network. A private endpoint lets the bucket accept only your own traffic.
a5c4e002-aa8f-4088-a26e-3ba59830ba84.action: Add a free S3 gateway endpoint and let the bucket be reached only through it.

d4831d89-2615-442e-bf98-81d30627e116.title: Three gaps line up into a path to the card data
d4831d89-2615-442e-bf98-81d30627e116.analogy: Like an unlocked side door, a front desk that hands out keys, and a master key on the ring, all at once.
d4831d89-2615-442e-bf98-81d30627e116.what_could_happen: An attacker who tricks the web server can take its access keys and download or delete every card record. This is the pattern behind the 2019 Capital One breach.
d4831d89-2615-442e-bf98-81d30627e116.action: The fixes for IMDSv2, the server's access and the private storage route each break the chain. Once they're done, test that it's closed.

e7983266-071a-48d5-9208-3b7cac99e75a.title: Card data travels to the website unencrypted
e7983266-071a-48d5-9208-3b7cac99e75a.analogy: Like reading card numbers aloud on a phone line others can listen in on.
e7983266-071a-48d5-9208-3b7cac99e75a.what_could_happen: Anyone on the network path can read or change what customers send, and it breaks PCI-DSS requirement 4.
e7983266-071a-48d5-9208-3b7cac99e75a.action: Serve the site over HTTPS with a free AWS certificate on a load balancer, and require HTTPS for storage calls.

624a4c66-8f2d-4c22-96af-0702aa6274ac.title: The whole platform runs on one server
624a4c66-8f2d-4c22-96af-0702aa6274ac.analogy: Like a shop with one cashier and no one to cover.
624a4c66-8f2d-4c22-96af-0702aa6274ac.what_could_happen: A crash, a reboot for patching or a data-center problem takes the card platform offline until someone fixes it.
624a4c66-8f2d-4c22-96af-0702aa6274ac.action: Run a second server in another data center behind the load balancer from the HTTPS fix, with automatic replacement.

458d3366-73cc-4245-bc41-bb9f75077e80.title: No extra data-transfer charge here
458d3366-73cc-4245-bc41-bb9f75077e80.analogy: Like worrying about tolls on a road that has none.
458d3366-73cc-4245-bc41-bb9f75077e80.what_could_happen: Nothing: transfer between the server and S3 in the same region is free. The reviewer corrected this finding.
458d3366-73cc-4245-bc41-bb9f75077e80.action: No change needed for cost. The private storage route is its own item.

02675180-cc09-4d57-aa33-1ee0e351d591.title: The internet-facing server is only checked every 5 minutes
02675180-cc09-4d57-aa33-1ee0e351d591.analogy: Like a guard who glances at the cameras every five minutes.
02675180-cc09-4d57-aa33-1ee0e351d591.what_could_happen: Short attacks and spikes fall between checks, so an intrusion is noticed later.
02675180-cc09-4d57-aa33-1ee0e351d591.action: Turn on 1-minute monitoring and record network traffic (VPC Flow Logs).

dc306f91-1060-49a8-8a13-f828085c9877.title: Database storage is encrypted
dc306f91-1060-49a8-8a13-f828085c9877.analogy: Like records kept in a locked safe.
dc306f91-1060-49a8-8a13-f828085c9877.what_could_happen: Little: stored data is protected. A customer-managed key would add control over who can decrypt it.
dc306f91-1060-49a8-8a13-f828085c9877.action: Optional: switch to a customer-managed key for tighter control.

bb7583eb-3b42-465d-8e88-118da17c6dbf.title: Backups only reach back one week
bb7583eb-3b42-465d-8e88-118da17c6dbf.analogy: Like a security camera that keeps a week of footage.
bb7583eb-3b42-465d-8e88-118da17c6dbf.what_could_happen: A data problem found after 7 days can't be rolled back from the automatic backups.
bb7583eb-3b42-465d-8e88-118da17c6dbf.action: Keep production backups for 14 to 35 days.

f733eeb9-95af-4a11-a214-233823c13248.title: Database logins use shared passwords
f733eeb9-95af-4a11-a214-233823c13248.analogy: Like an office where everyone shares one door code.
f733eeb9-95af-4a11-a214-233823c13248.what_could_happen: A leaked password works for anyone, and there's no record of which person or app connected.
f733eeb9-95af-4a11-a214-233823c13248.action: Turn on IAM database sign-in so each app logs in with its own identity, recorded in CloudTrail.

9be7ea7a-796e-4242-8f7f-059e55f65f35.title: The database can't add capacity for deadline rushes
9be7ea7a-796e-4242-8f7f-059e55f65f35.analogy: Like a shop that never opens extra checkout lanes, even on its busiest day.
9be7ea7a-796e-4242-8f7f-059e55f65f35.what_could_happen: During filing deadlines the public website and API could slow down or fail to connect.
9be7ea7a-796e-4242-8f7f-059e55f65f35.action: Let Aurora add reader copies automatically at busy times and remove them afterwards.

54815d01-faa8-41f2-b9e0-9dfa33ec6d1b.title: Database logs aren't collected in one place
54815d01-faa8-41f2-b9e0-9dfa33ec6d1b.analogy: Like a building where each room keeps its own visitor log.
54815d01-faa8-41f2-b9e0-9dfa33ec6d1b.what_could_happen: Slow queries, failed logins and schema changes can't be seen or alerted on.
54815d01-faa8-41f2-b9e0-9dfa33ec6d1b.action: Export the PostgreSQL logs to CloudWatch Logs.

f0c95c6a-2aa1-4dec-8d6a-cc2faebf69dd.title: Backup labels are already copied
f0c95c6a-2aa1-4dec-8d6a-cc2faebf69dd.analogy: Like files that are already labeled.
f0c95c6a-2aa1-4dec-8d6a-cc2faebf69dd.what_could_happen: Nothing: all three clusters already copy tags to their snapshots. The reviewer corrected this finding.

e8b1caad-d6d6-494c-bec7-775c6a9d67b7.title: The production database spans only two data centers
e8b1caad-d6d6-494c-bec7-775c6a9d67b7.analogy: Like keeping three spare keys in only two houses.
e8b1caad-d6d6-494c-bec7-775c6a9d67b7.what_could_happen: If one data center fails, two of the three database copies could go down together, slowing the site or making failover take longer.
e8b1caad-d6d6-494c-bec7-775c6a9d67b7.action: Add a subnet in a third data center so the three copies spread out.

d65709cc-ff1a-4939-adb8-487b0e5a3fdc.title: No one is alerted when the database fails over
d65709cc-ff1a-4939-adb8-487b0e5a3fdc.analogy: Like a smoke detector with no siren.
d65709cc-ff1a-4939-adb8-487b0e5a3fdc.what_could_happen: A failover or failed backup during a filing rush could go unnoticed until users complain.
d65709cc-ff1a-4939-adb8-487b0e5a3fdc.action: Send database events to an alert topic the operations team watches.

c684c845-928f-4aee-9ae6-b47b84ecc634.title: Encryption keys change automatically
c684c845-928f-4aee-9ae6-b47b84ecc634.analogy: Like changing the locks on a schedule.
c684c845-928f-4aee-9ae6-b47b84ecc634.what_could_happen: Little: rotation is on. It's still worth checking that only the right services can use the keys.
c684c845-928f-4aee-9ae6-b47b84ecc634.action: Review who can use the keys; rotation needs no change.

109c426a-8cd9-4aa7-a906-80190c403742.title: The site has standard, not premium, protection against traffic floods
109c426a-8cd9-4aa7-a906-80190c403742.analogy: Like home insurance without flood cover.
109c426a-8cd9-4aa7-a906-80190c403742.what_could_happen: A very large flood of traffic could slow or block partner access and put the 99.9% target at risk.
109c426a-8cd9-4aa7-a906-80190c403742.action: Decide whether AWS Shield Advanced is worth it. For most workloads the Shield Standard protection already included is enough.

c8e05434-f498-4d2d-bcae-449edc8ab97e.title: Audit logs are stored so they can't be altered
c8e05434-f498-4d2d-bcae-449edc8ab97e.what_could_happen: Little, as long as the lock is in compliance mode with a long enough retention period.
c8e05434-f498-4d2d-bcae-449edc8ab97e.action: Check that the lock mode and retention period match the record-keeping policy.

9dacdaed-4075-43aa-bc54-fcae707bb67b.title: It's unclear which key encrypts the audit logs
9dacdaed-4075-43aa-bc54-fcae707bb67b.analogy: Like knowing a safe is locked but not who holds the key.
9dacdaed-4075-43aa-bc54-fcae707bb67b.what_could_happen: With an AWS-managed key, you can't control or audit exactly who can decrypt the health-data audit logs.
9dacdaed-4075-43aa-bc54-fcae707bb67b.action: Point the log bucket's encryption at the customer-managed key the project already creates.

ade46b43-d232-4874-aee0-631426150e03.title: Partner access controls aren't visible in this code
ade46b43-d232-4874-aee0-631426150e03.analogy: Like a building with three tenant companies where you can't see whose badge opens which floor.
ade46b43-d232-4874-aee0-631426150e03.what_could_happen: If partners share credentials, one compromised partner could reach another partner's Medicare claims data.
ade46b43-d232-4874-aee0-631426150e03.action: Confirm each partner type has its own narrowly scoped role or API credentials, set up outside this code.

4454b72d-f729-41d7-b273-0667fc1ee571.title: Backups run on four schedules
4454b72d-f729-41d7-b273-0667fc1ee571.analogy: Like daily, weekly and monthly copies, kept in two places.
4454b72d-f729-41d7-b273-0667fc1ee571.what_could_happen: Little: the code keeps backups every 4 hours (1 day), daily (7 days), weekly (35 days) and monthly (90 days), with copies in a second vault. The reviewer checked this.
4454b72d-f729-41d7-b273-0667fc1ee571.action: Confirm 90 days meets the record-keeping policy.

c89a5c02-0b75-407b-b71c-fd379e931602.title: Problems aren't sent to the on-call team automatically
c89a5c02-0b75-407b-b71c-fd379e931602.analogy: Like alarms ringing in an empty room.
c89a5c02-0b75-407b-b71c-fd379e931602.what_could_happen: A key, firewall or backup problem could go unnoticed until a partner reports a failure.
c89a5c02-0b75-407b-b71c-fd379e931602.action: Send AWS Health and backup events to the team's incident system with EventBridge rules.
